desc.zh: 区分双亲冲突与环，用过滤后的森林找出该删的有向边。
desc.en: Separate a two-parent conflict from a cycle and repair the filtered forest.

complexity: O(n α(n)) amortized time; O(n) auxiliary space

concepts.name: Two-parent filtering
concepts.description: Skip the later incoming edge before cycle detection.

concepts.name: Filtered forest invariant
concepts.description: DSU groups equal the undirected components of retained edges.
